title: Epikloop project marker
description: The committed .epikloop/project.json that makes a repository an Epikloop project. Teammates get identical behaviour because the project describes itself.

id.description: Project id, derived once when the project is created: the first 12 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the normalized git remote (host/owner/repo, lowercased, without scheme, credentials or .git), or of the repository path when there is no remote. Committed, so moved and re-cloned repos keep their state.

lane.description: Lane profile: web, service, mobile-expo, mobile-flutter, or a community lane.

mode.description: Team mode adds one required GitHub check that runs scripts/check.sh on pull requests; solo mode has no workflow.

mvp_frozen.description: Date the MVP set was frozen by plan. It moves only by a recorded decision.

hours_per_day.description: Hours per day the human works on the project; an input to the ETA.

deadline.description: Target date, when there is one.

commands.description: Stack commands. Blanks are auto-detected for Node, Python, Go and Rust.

token_ignore.description: Exceptions to the token gate, each with its reason.

path.description: Glob relative to the repository root.

allow_workflows.description: Workflow files that solo mode tolerates; any other workflow fails the gates.

effort_overrides.description: Story-worker effort per tier. Precedence: this file, then ~/.epikloop/config.json, then the plugin defaults (T1 medium, T2 high, T3 xhigh).
